dct_title_s: Satellite detected water extent in Bagmati, Gandaki, Lumbini and Madhesh Provinces, Nepal as of 01 & 06 October 2024
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: FL20240928NPL** This map illustrates the floods using Sentinel-2 images acquired on 01 & 06 October 2024 at 10:42 local time (04:57 UTC). Within the analysed area of about 18,000 km², a total of about 300 km² of land appears to be affected by flood waters. Based on Worldpop spatial demographic data, about 115,000 people are exposed or living close to flooded areas. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
